_about: Logistic model over sentinel features. Chat weights are learned by `clipengine train` from past streams (label: viewers clipped it); audio_z and crowd_new are set by hand.

eval.note: General detector: trained on 20+ big English streams in GTA VI and Just Chatting outside any one channel's roster; held-out recall 0.44 of top-10 viewer-clipped moments at ~6.2 false fires/h (trigger 0.7). Retrain on your own streamers with `clipengine train`.
